preconditions.description: The number of shamans is between 2 and 100000.
Each shaman can trust at most 500 other shamans.

postconditions.description: The output for each query is the minimum distance the whispered formula had to travel.

invariants.expression: N, D, U, Q are initialized correctly
invariants.description: The number of shamans, the maximum number of trusted friends, the number of days, and the number of questions are initialized correctly.

invariants.expression: H_i values are within the specified range
invariants.description: The altitude values of the shamans are within the specified range.
The trust relationships between shamans are updated correctly based on the given log.
Each query is answered correctly based on the current state of trust relationships and altitude values.
